wholePhysicalScope: Native OpenStreetMap outlines and named building parts, published operator structural envelope and existing public-domain Qualla photo of the north entrance and west side.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the polygonal roof, pilasters, glass entrance and plinth.
limitations: The model includes the principal palace. The detached landscape, fountains, plaza monuments and underground facilities sit outside the model scope.
Glazing subdivisions and the secondary elevations are approximated where the confirmed photo is incomplete. The original sculpture on the entrance panel is omitted.
